properties.name: aspect
properties.comment: How the design space maps onto the arranged size (stage VA, decision 10): stretch, each axis at its own ratio (the default), or uniform, one scale (the smaller axis ratio) keeping the design's proportions, aligned by viewport_fit's alignment. Either is an explicit, recorded stretch. Throws std::invalid_argument for a value outside ScaledAspect.

table.description: How the design space maps onto the arranged size: stretch or uniform.

prepare: if (static_cast<std::uint8_t>(incoming) > static_cast<std::uint8_t>(ScaledAspect::uniform)) throw std::invalid_argument("ScaledPanel aspect is not a ScaledAspect");
